We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 \\ 5 & 8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}(-7)\cdot 4+3\cdot (-2) \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-34 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 \\ 5 & 8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-34 \\ 5\cdot 4+8\cdot (-2)\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-34 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 \\ 5 & 8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-34 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$
